sim_note: line_buf_ram instantiates the Gowin DPX9B BSRAM primitive directly (18-bit mode, addrbe-encoded addresses); include sim/gowin_bsram_sim.v in iverilog compiles for its behavioral model.
description: Shared line-buffer + 3x3 window extractor: 2 BSRAM line buffers + column taps, emits one 9-tap window per output pixel in row-major order with edge-replication borders.

clock_reset.clk_en: step enable on every sequential element; tie 1 for full rate

stream_protocol: input rows: dedicated 1-beat new_line then IMG_W pix_valid beats; output: IMG_H x IMG_W results in row-major order, out_valid per beat, new_line_out on first result of each row. All sequential logic gated by clk_en (tie 1 for full-rate operation).
border_policy: edge replication (clamp): tap(r,c) = I[clamp(y+r-1,0,H-1)][clamp(x+c-1,0,W-1)]; identical in tools/golden_model.py

validation.sim: iverilog PASS (full 3F / mask 0F / mask 30) + UART report
